name: ensemble_signal_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, four algorithmically-watched signals — session VWAP deviation, EMA trend alignment (1-min vs 5-min), Bollinger Band position, and 2-min RSI — are monitored by distinct participant archetypes: VWAP-benchmarked institutional desks, short-term trend systems, volatility traders, and momentum-fade algos. When at least 3 of these 4 signals simultaneously agree on direction, it identifies the 'trend-pullback-oversold' microstructure state: NIFTY is in an established short-term uptrend (EMA12 > EMA60), has briefly dipped below session VWAP under selling pressure (VWAP deviation +1), and RSI has reached a short-term oversold level (<35), while Bollinger Bands remain neutral. This convergence signals that multiple algorithm types are about to layer buy orders simultaneously, creating a 10-20 spot point directional push over the next 30-90 seconds.
core_signal_oneliner: 3-of-4 sub-signal consensus (VWAP, EMA alignment, Bollinger, RSI) with EMA trend anchor confirmed over 2 consecutive bars
